DEEP INTOTHE AMAZON

Explore ExperiencesPlan Your Stay

An authentic retreat in the heart of the Amazon.

Amazon Adventure Lodge is an authentic retreat on the shores of Lago do Maçarico, inspired by traditional Amazon riverside architecture and designed to connect guests with the forest, biodiversity, culture and local ways of life.

Experiences

AMAZON JOURNEYS

Editorial cards for comparing duration, pace and focus.

01

2-Day Amazon Adventure Lodge Experience

2 Days / 1 Night · From R$ 2.000 per person

A compact Amazon introduction combining the Meeting of the Waters, canoe exploration, sunrise, sunset, guided jungle interpretation and night caiman spotting.

Explore this experience
02

Amazon Jungle Tour: 3 Days / 2 Nights

3 Days / 2 Nights · From R$ 2.523 per person

A balanced lodge program with canoe exploration, forest interpretation and a respectful riverside family visit to understand local Amazon ways of life.

Explore this experience
03

4-Day Lago Maçarico Amazon Tour

4 Days / 3 Nights · From R$ 2.997,59 per person

A deeper Lago Maçarico itinerary adding forest camping, practical survival interpretation and seasonal activities shaped by weather and water levels.

Explore this experience
04

Amazon Jungle Expedition: 5 Days from Manaus

5 Days / 4 Nights · From R$ 3.483,99 per person

A longer expedition rhythm combining lodge comfort, forest trails, canoe exploration, riverside culture, camping, survival interpretation and night activities.

Explore this experience
05

Amazon Survival Tours

Approximately 4 Days / 3 Nights · R$ 3.923,41 per person

A guided survival-focused program with practical forest knowledge, hammock camping, navigation, botany and responsible wildlife observation.

Explore this experience
06

Amazon Sport Fishing Lodge

5 Days / 4 Nights · From R$ 1.300 per person

Sport fishing based around Lago do Maçarico, Juma River and Mamori Channel with local guides, catch-and-release context and no promise of guaranteed species or catch rates.

Explore this experience

Activities

IMMERSION AT A NATURAL PACE

Wildlife and forest encounters are approached respectfully, always depending on weather, water levels and the conditions of the day.

  • Meeting of the Waters
  • Amazon sunrise
  • Amazon sunset
  • canoe exploration
  • flooded forest
  • bird watching
  • opportunity to observe pink and gray dolphins
  • night caiman spotting when conditions allow
  • jungle trekking
  • medicinal plant interpretation
  • piranha fishing
  • riverside culture
  • jungle camping
  • survival techniques
  • sport fishing
